text: ສະບາຍດີ ທ່ານຜູ້ຊົມທຸກທ່ານ ຍິນດີຕ້ອນຮັບເຂົ້າສູ່ລາຍການເຕະບານຂອງພວກເຮົາ ມື້ນີ້ເຮົາຈະມາເວົ້າເລື່ອງ Premier  League  ແລະ Champions  League
desc: An adult woman around thirty with a clear, bright voice at a natural medium pitch, not high-pitched. Professional sports presenter, crisp precise enunciation, lively and confident, fluent in English
